These files are the official CDN builds from the npm package "firebase@12.19.0",
self-hosted so the site does not depend on a third-party script host.
The only change: import URLs were rewritten from https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/
to relative "./" paths, and source-map comments were removed.
